name: orchestrator-mvp
description: Analyse a prompt with Opus, split it into subtasks, route each to the best Claude/Codex model, run them via CLI, and combine the result.

orchestratorMvp.mainModel.markdownDescription: The main orchestrator model (Claude) that analyses the prompt, decomposes it into subtasks, and combines the final result.

orchestratorMvp.mainEffort.description: Effort level for the main Claude orchestrator model.

orchestratorMvp.claudePath.description: Path to the Claude Code CLI binary.

orchestratorMvp.codexPath.description: Path to the Codex CLI binary.

orchestratorMvp.usageFloorPercent.markdownDescription: Headroom floor for usage-aware routing. If a provider has less than this % of its quota left, a subtask routed to it is moved to the other provider (when that one is healthier). Difficulty still decides the model first; this only demotes a low provider.

orchestratorMvp.overwrite.markdownDescription:
How to treat an existing file whose content would change.

- `backup` (default): overwrite, but save the previous version under `.orchestrator/<timestamp>/backup/` so nothing is lost.
- `overwrite`: replace it outright.
- `skip`: keep the existing file and write the new version alongside as `<name>.orchestrator-new`.

Identical files are never rewritten.

orchestratorMvp.maxRunTokens.markdownDescription: Per-run token budget (input + output across all subtasks). When the total reaches this, remaining subtasks are skipped instead of run. `0` means no cap.
